title: feat(spec): a navigation entry may declare one API data source, which its visible reads as data
body:
Part of #24332 (the `visible` half of shape 1 lands here; the `label` and record-target halves stay open on the card as two forks, below).

Clause-②: yes (widening)

## What this does

A navigation entry may declare ONE API data source, the page element's `ElementApiDataSourceSchema` BY REFERENCE (`packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts`), and its `visible` reads the bound value as `data`:

```ts
{ id: 'nav_environments', type: 'object', objectName: 'sys_environment',
  dataSource: { provider: 'api', read: { url: '/api/v1/cloud/home' }, path: 'data.environments' },
  visible: 'data.total == 1' }
```

- `packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts`: `BaseNavItemSchema` gains `dataSource: ElementApiDataSourceSchema.optional()`, so the nine branches that spread the base carry it (`object`, `dashboard`, `page`, `url`, `report`, `action`, `component`, `doc`, `group`). A `separator` spreads nothing and refuses it with its own prescription (the key joins `SEPARATOR_NAV_ITEM_GUIDANCE`). The `visible` describe now says an entry with a `dataSource` reads it as `data`, and an entry without one has no `data`.
- The describe opens with `[PLANNED — not yet rendered]` and claims no reader. Only `visible` reads `data`: the describe says `label` and the target keys (`recordId`, `filters`, `params`) take no `data` read, and a group's binding is not published to its `children`.
- `packages/spec/liveness/app.json`: row `navigation.children.dataSource`, graded `planned`, `authorWarn: true` with an `authorHint`, and drilled `provider` / `read.url` / `read.method` / `path`. `check:liveness` refuses an undeclared container inheritance, so the four child keys are drilled. The carrier is the objectui renderer half, which the seat files when this lands. The precedent for `planned` + `authorWarn` in this same file is `navigation.runAction` before objectui#5216.
- Generated by their generators only: `authorable-surface/ui.json` (+9 rows, one per branch), `content/docs/references/ui/app.mdx`, `liveness/state-counts/app.md`.
- `.changeset/24332-nav-item-api-data-source.md`: `@objectstack/spec` minor.

## The premise, measured before building (ruling item 2)

| Hypothesis | Reading |
|:--|:--|
| H1: no import cycle | Holds. `page.zod.ts`'s transitive import closure is 52 files and does not contain `app.zod.ts`. Nothing moved. |
| H2: the `data` root | objectui at the `.objectui-sha` pin `0707b4ae37` and at main `749ed76` gives the same reading. `objectui: packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx` reads a node's API binding (`useElementApiDataSource`) and puts the answer in that node's evaluation scope as `data` (pin `:1157`/`:1231`, main `:1174`/`:1248`). That one `ExpressionEvaluator` serves the node's `${…}` text holes, inline locale-map members included (objectui#12936), and its `visibleWhen` (CEL envelope via `evaluateCondition`). The binding is RENDERED at the pin, so the spec's `[PLANNED]` text on `ElementApiDataSourceSchema` and the "no `data` root" text on `visibleWhen` are stale. That is #24300's surface, held off here. |
| H3a: `visible` | Holds. `objectui: packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useNavMemberGates.ts` evaluates a nav `visible` through `evaluateNavigationVisibility` with the same `ExpressionEvaluator.evaluateCondition`, so a per-entry `data` in scope is the same dialect and the same root name. **Built.** |
| H3b: `label` | The dialect holds (`${…}` in a string or an inline-map member), but the label has a layer a page element does not: `translateApp` (`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`) REPLACES a present label with the bundle entry keyed by the entry id, and `walkNavigation` in `packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts` seeds every present label into the bundle as a translatable literal. The ruled row's own entry (`nav_environments`) has a zh-CN bundle entry, so a data label there would show the static noun in zh-CN. How a data-bearing label meets translation is a contract decision. **Not built**, see open question 1. |
| H3c: `recordId` | Fails. `objectui: packages/layout/src/NavigationRenderer.tsx` `resolveHref` substitutes `recordId` through `applyNavTemplate`, whose vocabulary is `{current_user_id}`, `{current_org_id}` and a context selector's own `{id}` (single brace, no dots). A `${data.id}` there is taken as written. Reading data would add a second template dialect to the field, or a second spelling of a data read. **Not built**, see open question 2. |
| H4: which types | Every branch that spreads the base. objectui's item guard (`passesNavItemGuards`) evaluates `visible` on every type, `group` included, so a group can honour its own binding. |

## Tests (all at `98e3434b0e`, the PR head, unless noted)

- New `packages/spec/src/ui/app-nav-item-api-data-source.test.ts`: 19 tests. Every branch parses with the binding and a `data.*` `visible`; the app door accepts it on a top-level entry and on a group's child; and the bare binding parses. Five refusals are each compared with the page element binding's own issues for the same value (`code` + `path`, not prose): unknown key, off-origin `read.url` (3 shapes), credential key, `POST`, object binding. A separator refuses the key. The describe marker and the `planned` liveness row are pinned.
- Ablation, once (the diff adds the accept behaviour these tests pin): `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` renamed the key to `dataSourceAblated`, with anchor x1 → x0 and blob `791b2943` → `c37dfcd0`. Result: **17 failed / 2 passed** (the separator refusal and the ledger row stay green, as they should). Restored, blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. The tests import `./app.zod` from source, so no dist leg applies.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: 697 files, 21270 passed (at `82e723d6e5`; the merge after it brought no `packages/spec` change). `typecheck` passed, and `check:test-typecheck` OK.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: all 14 artifacts up to date after a rebuild at `98e3434b0e`.
- Consumers (the accept set widens downstream; filter direction: these packages consume `@objectstack/spec`):
  - `@objectstack/lint` full suite: 145 files, 6864 passed. It includes `validate-nav-*`, `validate-translation-references` and `lint-liveness-properties`.
  - `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` full suite: 246 files passed (3 skipped), 20655 tests.
  - `@objectstack/cli` unit tier, NARROWED: the full unit tier ran past a 540 s bound (exit 124, NOT MEASURED, and declared to CI). The run covered `nav-contribution-groups*` and 23 `test/i18n-*` files: 25 files, 298 passed.
- A liveness lint probe on an app with the key on a top-level entry and on a group child returns one `liveness-planned-property` finding. The lint fans out over the top-level entries only, as the ledger README states.

## Gates

The derived list is `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on this diff: 111 families, plus `check:dev-prereqs` (local-only, touches the spec build). All 112 were run locally on `98e3434b0e`, and `--ran` reconciles 111 of 111. Every one exits 0 except:

- `pnpm check:platform-checklist`: **exit 1, red on `origin/main` as well**. The finding is `areas/access-security.json: ABSENT SYMBOL packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts#legacyGrantAnchorRetired`. This diff touches neither file. On `origin/main` `71fa166e96`, `legacyGrant` has 0 hits in that file, against a control of `export` with 13 hits. Reported to the seat.

Six families first answered exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: no lint / client / objectql dist). After the consumer closure build (turbo, 62 tasks, all cache hits), all six re-ran with exit 0: `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:doc-security-posture`, `check:skill-examples`, `check:docs-transcript-drift`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`.

## Open questions for the seat (also in the report on #24332)

1. **Label fork:** a data-bearing label and the bundle rung that replaces a present label by entry id.
2. **Target fork:** `recordId` has its own `{…}` template dialect.
3. **The narrowing arm, not shipped:** refusing `data.*` in a `visible` on an entry with no `dataSource`. It would be BREAKING and need an ADR-0087 disposition. Measured reach: 0 `data.` reads among the nav `visible` predicates in this repo's 38 navigation-declaring files. The control is the same files' `current_user` predicates, e.g. `packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts:2091`.
4. **Refusal wording:** the reused binding's refusals name a page element ("`read.url` of a page element's `api` data source …") on the navigation door too. That text is `page.zod.ts`'s, a hold-off for this card.

## Acceptance notes

- objectui's own nav mirror (`objectui: packages/types/src/zod/app.zod.ts`, `NavigationItemObject`) is a non-strict `z.object` and strips `dataSource`. This is renderer-half work for the carrier card.
- Whether an unbound `data.*` read in a nav `visible` FAULTS (and so withholds the entry under `evaluateNavigationVisibility`) or reads `undefined` is NOT MEASURED: objectui is not installed in this container. The `authorHint` says only that there is no value to read.
